description: Unexpired TLS certificates publicly logged for a domain (Certificate Transparency, via crt.sh with Cert Spotter as backup): subdomains (up to 500) and wildcards found, the 25 newest certificates, issuing authorities with counts, certificates issued in the last 7 days, expiry dates, and flags such as sudden new issuance. Useful for mapping a domain's attack surface or spotting look-alike infrastructure. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).
